    at_done = False
    n = len(s)
    while pos < n:
        if not at_done and pos + 1 < n and s[pos] == 'a' and s[pos+1] == 't':
            out.append('@')
            at_done = True

            pos += 3
        else:

            pos += 1
    print(''.join(out))

    main()
